A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the power-law index of the total mass density profile for the inner region (within several effective radii) of ETGs is $\gamma=1.5\pm0.2$ at 68\% CL.
the equation of state for the inner region of the dark matter of ETGs is $\gamma=2$ and $\omega\sim-1/3$, which is consistent with the results of cosmology and the theory of general relativity.

we have shown that the equation of state for the dark matter in the inner regions of galaxies is $\omega\sim-1/3$, which is very close the equation of state in the standard cosmological model, $\Lambda$CDM.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the equation of state in the inner region is very close to that of a cosmological constant, which is a very important clue for the nature of dark matter in galaxies.
the equation of state for the inner regions in ETGs is $\sim -1/3$ and the power-law index of the total mass density profile in the inner regions is $\gamma\sim 1.75$.
the equation of state for dark matter is not a constant, but it varies in the inner regions of galaxies.
